title: Second moment of a centered affine transform
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with a probability distribution $P$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ have mean zero. For any $d,e\in\mathbb{R}$, the second moment of $dX+e$ is $d^2\mathbb{E}[X^2]+e^2$.
